components.name: Primary Analysis Action
components.description: Muted-iris action for analyzing a source URL.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #D1C2EE; border-radius: 8px; background: #B7A6E3; color: #211D2A; font: 700 11px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: #D7C9F0; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7C9F0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Source URL Field
components.description: Inset source field with clear URL affordance.
components.css: .ds-source-field { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid #414658; border-radius: 11px; background: #171B27; color: #F0EEE9; } .ds-source-field input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 13px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-source-field input::placeholder { color: #9695A2; opacity: 1; } .ds-source-field:focus-within { border-color: #8B7CA9; } .ds-source-field input:focus-visible { outline: 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Quiet top navigation with an iris underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 76px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #F0EEE9; font: 600 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; background: #B7A6E3; content: ''; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7C9F0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sample Label
components.description: Soft pill disclosing synthetic playlist content.
components.css: .ds-sample-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #494356; border-radius: 100px; background: #211F2A; color: #C7B8E7; font: 600 9px Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.name: Preferences Surface
components.description: Single contained area for format, quality, and destination.
components.css: .ds-preferences { padding: 23px; border: 1px solid #303545; border-radius: 16px; background: #1B202D; color: #F0EEE9; } .ds-preferences h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 22px/1.2 Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-preferences p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: #A1A1AF; font: 400 11px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.name: Playlist Row
components.description: Spacious row that keeps order, duration, and status aligned.
components.css: .ds-playlist-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 88px 118px; align-items: center; min-height: 71px; border-top: 1px solid #2B2E3B; color: #F0EEE9; font: 500 13px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-playlist-row:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 2.5%); } .ds-playlist-row > span { color: #C5C3CC; font-size: 11px; } .ds-playlist-row .ds-status { color: #C5C3CC; font-size: 10px; } .ds-playlist-row .ds-status::before { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-right: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9AC8B4; content: ''; }

components.name: Selected Format
components.description: Softly selected choice inside the format group.
components.css: .ds-format-option { display: grid; place-content: center; gap: 3px; min-height: 50px; border: 1px solid #4A435E; border-radius: 8px; background: #2B2737; color: #E1D6F4; font: 600 11px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-format-option small { color: inherit; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-format-option:hover { background: #342F42; } .ds-format-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7C9F0; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Clipoteca feels like a carefully kept personal media collection, not a broadcast console or an industrial control surface. The interface gives the source URL a clear place, then lets the playlist read like a considered catalogue: roomy rows, quiet metadata, and unmistakable choices.

The dark blue-ink setting remains calm rather than dramatic. Manrope is used throughout for a clear, consistent desktop interface; stronger weight and compact spacing distinguish headings from controls. Muted iris marks the selected state and the primary action without turning the whole screen into an accent-colored dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Personal archive mood with an editorial display voice.
Dark blue-ink surfaces and soft ivory text.
Muted iris accent for selected and primary states.
C-shaped archive-frame mark with an index tab; draft pending owner approval.
Playlist rows remain explicit, ordered, and easy to scan.
Prototype content and unavailable items are clearly disclosed.

rules.name: The Iris Restraint Rule
rules.body: Muted iris marks an action or a selected state; it does not decorate every surface.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Panels are distinguished by one tonal step and one outline; do not nest containers to manufacture hierarchy.

dos: Do make the source URL and primary analysis action the first clear task.
Do give playlist titles room to breathe and keep duration and availability aligned.
Do identify sample content and unimplemented actions honestly.
Do use muted iris for focus and selection, not for broad decoration.
donts: Don't return to the previous dense industrial-console composition.
Don't use poster-wall browsing as the default playlist layout.
Don't make editorial typography smaller or denser than operational text can support.
Don't imply sample metadata or destination settings are already saved.
